capabilities: Transcribe voice memos into structured notes with summaries and tasks
Extract text from images as Markdown
Chat with the active note or the whole vault using semantic search with citations
Run AI selection actions like summarize, improve, and translate
Suggest tags, wrap note mentions in links, and apply AI edits with diffs
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; the README gives manual installation steps. Includes a privacy/network audit section and a warning that remote-server mode sends note content to that machine and stores tokens unencrypted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI features, and most AI plugins send note content to cloud services, so privacy-conscious users need local inference support.
